name: Clinical Survival Drill - Clarifying Orders
_note: Skill drill for safe clinical English: clarify unclear instructions, read back numbers, and speak up respectfully.

anchors.90-100: Repeats doses, times, names, and actions accurately
anchors.70-80: Mostly accurate with minor non-critical slips
anchors.50-60: Some details missed but repairs them

anchors.90-100: Clarifies ambiguity, reads back, and escalates concerns appropriately
anchors.70-80: Usually asks for clarification and confirms key details
anchors.50-60: Clarifies some details but misses opportunities

anchors.90-100: Calm, concise, and fluent even when rushed
Speaks up respectfully and protects patient safety

checklist.item: asked for repetition or clarification when details were unclear
read back key numbers, doses, timing, or patient identifiers
used a respectful phrase to raise a safety concern
confirmed the final plan before acting
kept the clarification concise rather than apologizing excessively
